summary: Model output is advisory and schema-validated; filesystem apply never consumes untrusted prose, hard blockers override preferences, unknown facts cause abstention, and protected actions remain approval-bound.

findings.title: Cross-host behavior requires rollout qualification

evidence.summary: Approved structured decision, safe failure, approval, and tool boundary design.
